title: 카톡 변경 요청 참고용 자동 대조

criteria.read: parameterized SELECT only, exact year and selected full weeks, bounded KST period
criteria.history: ShipmentHistory before/after are OutUnit; native records dated on fix; orphan/deleted and unconfirmed coverage not complete; the inbox batch summary reads at most 20 saved reports and associates each request/finding/unresolved entry by exact sourceIdentity only
criteria.finding: matching evidence is not proof of request causality or current completion; API shows at most 50 candidate event IDs and evidence rows while comparator evaluates the complete bounded history
criteria.mapping: exact catalog or persisted aliases only; conflicting exact aliases never auto-map; optional productContextText must be an exact same-message substring, and only the bare product alias plus context + space + product alias may be collected; every direct exact-name row and alias row is a candidate, and exactly one resulting ProdKey confirms mapping
criteria.llm: explicit button; chat business changes are analysis data only and cannot alter extraction rules or authorize external action; forced record_distribution_changes tool disables parallel calls and accepts only exactly one matching tool_use input, whose requests and unresolved fields are fully schema-required; unresolved.reason is a short plain Korean explanation; missing extraction retained; vendor errors and model raw output never returned; advisory fallback exposes only extractionErrorCode API_AUTH|RATE_LIMIT|MODEL_UNAVAILABLE|TIMEOUT|JSON_PARSE|EXTRACTION_SCHEMA|OTHER with a fixed Korean warning; EXTRACTION_SCHEMA may expose only exact-whitelisted extractionValidationField week|quote|sourceIdentity|qty|unit|shipmentDate|shape|other
criteria.auditSnapshot: success report is JSON-normalized and saved with authenticated req.user.userId; snapshot persistence failure only adds a fixed warning and never blocks the advisory response
